rules: Exp010 selected model must not change
Exp010 scaler must not change
Exp010 20-feature contract must not change
window size must remain 100 eligible packets
window stride must remain 100 eligible packets
threshold must remain 0.50
Exp011 data must not be used for training
Exp011 data must not be used to refit the scaler
Exp011 data must not be used for threshold optimization
Exp011 data must not be used for model selection
ground-truth labels must not enter feature extraction
ground-truth labels must not enter model inference
ground-truth labels must not trigger mitigation
mitigation must be triggered by the frozen model decision
failed or poor valid runs must not be silently deleted
valid-run criteria must be frozen before result-bearing execution
result-bearing runs must not be silently rerun
latency must be measured from recorded timestamps
Exp006 batch timing must not be represented as Exp011 live latency
a model BLOCK decision alone must not be represented as successful mitigation
actual enforcement must be independently evidenced
packet windows within a run must not be treated as independent experimental replicates
controlled-laboratory results must not be represented as production or arbitrary-DDoS performance
